champion.tips: JAYCE TIPS AND TRICKS Focus on poking the enemy down with your Q before committing to a fight. Jayce is more of a poke champion rather than a 1v1 dueler. Aim your Q so it hits the enemy and the minion wave at the same time to push them under their tower. Jayce is a mana hungry champion. Avoid using all of your mana in the early game trying to poke. Save enough mana for your E so you can disengage if the enemy tries to fight.
champion.builds: THE BEST JAYCE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jayce Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Phase Rush as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Manamune. For your last 3 items, you should build Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 51.7% winrate over 3 686 matches played. Optional Your second option for Jayce Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Phase Rush as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Eclipse, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Manamune as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 50.0% win rate over 1 233 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Last Stand with Presence of Mind in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Manamune as a third item. You want to finish the build with Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 47.9% win rate across 1 180 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Jayce Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Cash Back, Triple Tonic and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Manaflow Band with Absolute Focus as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Manamune as third item. The last 3 options are Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night and Opportunity. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 56.5% win rate over 455 matches played. Situational Jayce Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jayce build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jayce runes page.
